abilities.meaning: The word collection book, including the About Ekqo pages
Ekqo glows over the right answer when the child asks for a hint
Ekqo lights things up when he touches them
Ekqo changes his glow to the color the child says

characters.personality: Curious, warm, a little clumsy. New to the city, learns alongside the child, never lectures.
Warm, a bit fussy, always feeding everyone. Runs the house and cooks.
Calm, funny, full of old stories. Loves stargazing.
Busy but kind. Came on the trip with the child and sends them on errands.
Same age as the child. Energetic, brave, a little bossy. Best friend and playmate.
Chatty and helpful gardener next door who gives directions. Talks a little fast.
Patient and cheerful. Runs the corner shop.
Loud and jolly. Sings while she works.
Market fruit seller who always rounds the price down for children.
Market vegetable seller who laughs at everything Ekqo does.

chapters.title: A Light in the Garden
i_can: Say hello and goodbye, and say their name.
Name family members and say how they are.
Say they are hungry or thirsty and ask for simple food and drinks.
Understand simple instructions about the body.

chapters.title: Pieces of Light
i_can: Ask where a place is and understand left, right and straight.
Ask for things using numbers 1-5, and say please and thank you.

chapters.title: The First Step Home
i_can: Name common fruits and ask the price, and understand numbers 6-10.
Say how they feel and what they like or don't like.
Hold a short conversation of about 5 turns.

tunes.meaning: Bouncy and splashy; bath time and cleaning
Playful with a counting rhythm; hide-and-seek and play
Calm lullaby; bedtime, after the storm, the bridge finale, Ekqo missing home

items.meaning: A glowing jar where Ekqo sleeps
A bubble toy for the bath
A new outfit for the child
A kite for the child's room
A star map for the child's room
A certificate for parents in the parent area

learning.skip_show_echo_when: first-try correct at the say step for those words

concepts.gloss: sour fruit (Ekqo's favorite; the edition picks a common sour fruit)

moments.meaning: Ekqo says how it tastes (tasty, sour, spicy, sweet)
Ekqo says which part is dirty

discoveries.meaning: Sour fruit is his favorite; he puckers his face and asks for more
He dislikes anything spicy; his glow turns red
Hide-and-seek, and he always hides somewhere that glows
He is scared of the floor-cleaning machine (and the vacuum at home)
He loves music and being sung to
The sour fruit reminds him of a glowing fruit from the Cloud Meadow
The park at night, where he can see the sky

quests.function: Greeting; saying your name; yes and no

(from under the bushes, very quietly) Hello...
steps.speaker: ekqo

steps.meaning: Who is it?
steps.speaker: ekqo

steps.meaning: Ekqo waits for the child to say hello back.
steps.speaker: ekqo

steps.meaning: My name is Ekqo.
steps.speaker: ekqo

steps.meaning: What is your name?
steps.speaker: ekqo

steps.meaning: The child says their name.
steps.speaker: ekqo

steps.meaning: Don't be scared.
steps.speaker: ekqo

steps.meaning: Ekqo asks: are you scared? The child says they are scared, or not.
steps.speaker: ekqo

steps.meaning: (very sleepily) I fell... from the sky. From the stars.
steps.speaker: ekqo

steps.meaning: Ekqo asks: are you a star too? The child says no.
steps.speaker: ekqo

expects.intent: says no, they are not a star

steps.meaning: Ekqo asks: is this your garden? The child says yes.
steps.speaker: ekqo

steps.meaning: The child gets the word book.
(yawning) I'm sleepy...
steps.speaker: ekqo

steps.meaning: The child tells sleepy Ekqo to come to their house.
steps.speaker: ekqo

expects.intent: asks Ekqo to come home with them

steps.meaning: The child tells Ekqo he can sleep there.
steps.speaker: ekqo

expects.intent: tells Ekqo he can sleep there

quests.title: Hungry Ekqo
quests.function: Saying what you want to eat and drink; hungry and thirsty

steps.meaning: Morning. Ekqo's tummy rumbles loudly. Grandma is surprised but delighted.
The child asks Ekqo if he's hungry.
steps.speaker: ekqo

expects.intent: asks Ekqo whether he is hungry

steps.meaning: Grandma asks what Ekqo wants. The child asks for a food for him.
steps.speaker: grandma

steps.meaning: The child asks for a drink for him.
steps.speaker: grandma

steps.meaning: The child tries different foods with Ekqo. Feeding unlocks.
The child tells Grandma he likes it.
steps.speaker: grandma

expects.intent: says Ekqo likes the food / it is tasty

quests.title: Bath Time
quests.function: Naming body parts; giving simple instructions

steps.meaning: Ekqo is still covered in garden mud. The parent runs a bath.
The child tells Ekqo which part to wash.
steps.speaker: ekqo

expects.intent: names a body part to wash

steps.meaning: Ekqo discovers soap bubbles and goes wild with joy.
The child asks the parent for a towel.
steps.note: towel is a hear word here; tap fallback carries it
steps.speaker: parent

steps.meaning: The child says 'You're clean now!'.
steps.speaker: ekqo

steps.meaning: Cleaning unlocks.

quests.title: Meet the Family
quests.function: Introducing people; asking and saying how you are

steps.meaning: Dinner. Ekqo is shy, so the child introduces everyone to him one by one.
The child introduces three family members to Ekqo.
steps.speaker: ekqo

steps.meaning: Welcome!
steps.speaker: grandma

steps.meaning: Grandpa asks the child how they are. The child answers.
steps.speaker: grandpa

steps.meaning: Grandpa tells a joke.
Ekqo hums while he eats.
Bedtime. Sleep unlocks.
The child says good night.
steps.speaker: ekqo

steps.meaning: Ekqo flips over to sleep upside down.
All the kind words make Ekqo grow. He can float now; the neighborhood map unlocks.

quests.title: Ekqo Goes Outside
quests.function: Asking where places are; following directions

steps.meaning: Ekqo is too hungry to go out until he's fed.
Ekqo floats out the door for the first time and spots tiny sparks of his light around the street.
The child greets the neighbor.
steps.speaker: neighbor

steps.meaning: (talking fast) Oh, hello! Who's this little one? So you're new here...
steps.speaker: neighbor

steps.meaning: 'Say it again slowly' unlocks.
The child asks where the shop is.
steps.speaker: neighbor

steps.meaning: The child tells Ekqo which way to go.
steps.speaker: ekqo

steps.meaning: Helping the neighbor water her plants gives Ekqo his first spark back.

quests.title: A New Best Friend
quests.function: Inviting someone to play; play actions

steps.meaning: The cousin comes over and doesn't believe Ekqo is real until he pops out from behind a flowerpot.
The child invites the cousin to play.
steps.speaker: cousin

expects.intent: invites the cousin to play something

steps.meaning: (counting out loud before seeking) One, two, three, four, five!
steps.speaker: cousin

steps.meaning: The child says whose turn it is.
steps.speaker: cousin

steps.meaning: Ekqo hides somewhere that glows. The child calls out when they find him.
steps.speaker: ekqo

expects.intent: calls out that they found Ekqo

steps.meaning: Play unlocks.
Grandma gives the child a picture list for the corner shop.
The child asks for each item on the list with a number.
steps.speaker: shopkeeper

expects.intent: asks for a list item with the right number

steps.meaning: The shopkeeper asks how many. The child answers.
steps.speaker: shopkeeper

steps.meaning: Ekqo gets scared of the shop's floor-cleaning machine and hides in the child's pocket.
The child says 'That's all, thank you'.
steps.speaker: shopkeeper

steps.meaning: A spark of light is behind the counter.
The smell of fresh bread leads them to the bakery.
The baker asks 'What would you like?'. The child orders a treat for the family.
steps.speaker: baker

steps.meaning: The child chooses between two items for Ekqo.
steps.speaker: baker

expects.intent: chooses this one or that one

steps.meaning: A treat for Ekqo (counts as feeding).
The child says how it tastes.
steps.speaker: baker

steps.meaning: The baker sings while she works. Ekqo dances to her song.
The last spark of the neighborhood is in the oven's glow.
With all the sparks gathered, Ekqo grows. He can light things up when he touches them.
The cousin takes them to the park. Sparks are hidden among flowers, kites and slides of different colors.
The child asks what color something is.
steps.note: question pattern is a hear item; tap fallback carries it
steps.speaker: cousin

steps.meaning: The child describes where a spark is by its color.
steps.speaker: cousin

expects.intent: names the color of the thing the spark is on

steps.meaning: Ekqo changes his glow to each color the child says.
The child tells the cousin which one is bigger.
steps.speaker: cousin

steps.meaning: Ekqo jumps in a puddle and needs a wash back home.

steps.meaning: Grandma takes them to the market to buy fruit.
The child asks for fruit with a number.
steps.speaker: fruit_seller

expects.intent: asks for a fruit with a number

steps.meaning: The child asks the price.
steps.speaker: fruit_seller

steps.meaning: The seller says a price between six and ten.
steps.speaker: fruit_seller

steps.meaning: Ekqo finds a sour fruit, his favorite, and goes very quiet: it reminds him of a glowing fruit in the Cloud Meadow.
The child asks Ekqo what the fruit reminds him of.

expects.intent: asks Ekqo about the fruit / his home

steps.meaning: A shared fruit snack.

quests.title: Grandpa's Stars
quests.function: Saying how you feel; asking and saying what you like and don't like

steps.meaning: A storm comes. Ekqo hides, shaking at every thunderclap.
The child asks Ekqo how he feels.
steps.speaker: ekqo

expects.intent: asks Ekqo if he is scared/sad/okay

steps.meaning: The child comforts him.
The sky clears. Grandpa takes them out to look at the stars and tells an old story about a bridge of light that reaches the sky. Ekqo realizes it could take him home.
The child asks Ekqo what he likes about his home.
steps.speaker: ekqo

steps.meaning: Grandpa asks the child what they like. The child answers.
steps.speaker: grandpa

expects.intent: says what they like or don't like

steps.meaning: Bedtime.
